d: Enjoy all goals and match highlights from Republic of Ireland vs Tanzania in Group I of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026. Republic of Ireland secured a 3-1 group stage win at Aspire Zone in Doha as Cillian Murphy struck twice and Desmond Armstrong added a third, all in the first half, with Luqman Mbalasalu briefly levelling for Tanzania. Republic of Ireland finish second in Group I to reach the Round of 32, while Tanzania exit the tournament.
